pages.text: A facade hides a cable behind any full block.$(br2)Use a blank facade on the block you want to copy. The block is $(o)not$() consumed; you get a facade of it. Then use that facade on a cable face.

The cover is a real two pixel panel, not a sticker: you can see its edge when you look along the face, and it keeps the covering block's texture, tint and transparency.$(br2)Where a cable arm passes through that face, the panel becomes a frame with a hole for the arm.$(br2)The Configurator takes a facade back off, and breaking the cable returns every facade and upgrade it held.
